row.summary_en: Reduce intermediate representations with a smaller student architecture, then recover task quality through teacher supervision; the architecture determines representation size.
row.summary_zh: 通过缩小学生网络结构减少中间表示，再用教师监督恢复任务质量；表示规模由学生结构决定。

row.summary_en: Use low-rank approximation to reduce computation and storage for attention intermediates, focusing on efficient attention architectures; activation-aware weight factorization is covered separately.
row.summary_zh: 用低秩近似减少注意力中间矩阵的计算与存储，主要研究高效注意力架构；激活感知的权重分解另行讨论。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Represent intermediate inference activations with fewer bits to reduce their storage and transfer volume.
row.summary_zh: 用低比特数值表示推理中间激活，减少中间数据的存储和传输量。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Select out less important tokens, channels or activations so fewer intermediate elements enter subsequent computation.
row.summary_zh: 筛除不重要的 Token、通道或激活，使更少的中间数据参与后续计算。

row.summary_en: Reduce cache with a compact KV architecture, then recover task quality through teacher distillation; the cache structure determines compression, while distillation helps retain model capability.
row.summary_zh: 通过紧凑 KV 结构减少缓存，再用教师蒸馏恢复任务质量；缓存结构决定压缩幅度，蒸馏帮助保留模型能力。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Represent K/V with compact latent states or low-rank factors to reduce full-vector cache storage.
row.summary_zh: 用低维潜在表示或低秩因子保存 K/V，减少完整键值向量的缓存开销。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Store attention keys and values with fewer bits to reduce persistent cache storage.
row.summary_zh: 用低比特数值保存注意力的 Key 和 Value，降低持久缓存的存储量。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Prune redundant K/V channels or dimensions to reduce the representation size of each cached vector.
row.summary_zh: 裁减 K/V 的冗余通道或维度，缩小每个缓存向量的表示规模。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Transfer a larger model's capabilities to a smaller student that performs inference with fewer parameters.
row.summary_zh: 让较小的学生模型学习大模型的能力，以更少的参数完成推理任务。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Approximate a weight matrix with smaller low-rank factors to reduce its parameter representation.
row.summary_zh: 用多个较小的低秩矩阵近似原始权重矩阵，减少参数表示规模。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Represent model weights with fewer bits to reduce parameter storage and data read volume.
row.summary_zh: 用低比特数值表示模型权重，减少参数存储和读取的数据量。

row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–6; topic-specific applicability follows the linked research dossier
row.summary_en: Remove redundant weights or network components to reduce the model stored and executed at inference.
row.summary_zh: 移除冗余权重或网络结构，缩小推理时需要存储和执行的模型。
